title: In the Hunt (USA) V1.000 music preload
summary: Keep the original timed music preload and complete-read guard in source-loaded hooks.
rationale: Optional exact-source profile. The original first program has one pointer to each music routine and no relative BRA/BSR entries to them. Replace the first routine with the reviewed 108-byte source-loaded handlers and redirect the second music call to its copy hook. FAD 2612 supplies 0x54F00 bytes to 22400000; only a complete read enables the identical 002AA000 copy. The flag starts clear with the program and is cleared before every read. The existing 02000F04 sector-reader pointer is required. This preserves the music workaround; it does not remove it or claim to fix the deferred intermittent SMPC freeze. Other execution paths, Japanese revision and physical timing remain unqualified.

writes.effect: Embed the preload, guarded copy and initially clear flag in the first program.
writes.reason: Replace only the original music-loader routine; leave its single caller and other loading routines in place.

writes.effect: Redirect the second music call to the source-loaded guarded copy.
writes.reason: Preserve the original callback timing and skip copying after incomplete or failed reads.
